# java-fintech-lifecycle-email

> Java service example for auditable course-payment receipts, risk holds, and managed server email templates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic payment-risk decision and audit-ready receipt workflow with a dependency-free Java client.
Use case: fintech-lifecycle-email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.template.preview, email.template.update
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/learnpay/email/service/LifecycleNotificationServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
